hits.title: Raiven launches Raiven 2.0, bringing patented best-value sourcing to building trades procurement.
hits.snippet: Raiven launches Raiven 2.0, bringing patented best-value sourcing to building trades procurement.

hits.title: Raiven appoints Schneider Electric executive Bobby Cain to Board of Directors.
hits.snippet: The board appointment comes as Raiven continues to develop what it describes as an agentic Chief Procurement Office platform for electrical, HVAC and multi-trade contractors.

hits.title: Bobby Cain joins raiven Board of Directors.
hits.snippet: Raiven today announced that Robert (Bobby) W. Cain has joined its Board of Directors.

hits.title: Raiven and Itemize Partner to Deliver AI-Powered Procurement, PO Matching, and Spend Insights for Trades
hits.snippet: By combining Raiven's procurement platform with Itemize's AI-driven data capture and PO matching, customers can reconcile POs, invoices, and receipts faster and more accurately, while digitizing procurement data to gain real-time visibility into SKU-level purchasing, spend patterns, and supplier performance.

hits.title: Tempesta Media and Raiven Partner to Solve Contractors' Challenges
hits.snippet: In an industry-first, Tempesta Media is partnering with Raiven, a leading digital supply chain network that leverages AI to unlock savings of 7 to 30% on contractor supplies.

hits.title: Slovenia: Raiven Releases Acoustic Version of "Veronika"
hits.snippet: Raiven has released an acoustic version of "Veronika", the Slovene entry for the 2024 Eurovision Song Contest.

hits.title: United Rentals Joins Forces with Raiven, Enhancing Access to Equipment Rental Solutions
hits.snippet: United Rentals joins forces with Raiven, enhancing Access to equipment rental solutions.

hits.title: Slovenia: Raiven Confirmed for London Eurovision Party 2024
hits.snippet: Raiven has been announced as the first name in the line-up for the 2024 London Eurovision Party.

hits.title: Slovenia: Raiven releases her Eurovision entry 'Veronika'
hits.snippet: Raiven, the Slovenian Eurovision 2024 hopeful has released her Eurovision entry 'Veronika'.

hits.title: ChargePoint joins Raiven marketplace
hits.snippet: Raiven is excited to introduce the ChargePoint line of cutting-edge EV charging products to its marketplace.
